user_saw: The whole Gateway froze for several seconds when a shell snapshot was captured before a host command while the btrfs filesystem was committing a transaction.
summary: Shell snapshot capture now creates its private temp directory and output file with async node:fs/promises instead of fs-safe's withTempWorkspace, and exec preparation and upload-cleanup timers get main-thread stall task names.
reasoning: Shell snapshot capture has used fs-safe's withTempWorkspace since before the graft (f06ffe2bbe4 only swapped the in-repo re-export wrapper of the same @openclaw/fs-safe/temp function for a direct import), so no in-repo commit changed the behavior. The freeze comes from the external fs-safe dependency performing its native creates synchronously, which only hurt under production btrfs commit contention; I could not tie it to a specific fs-safe version bump (0.26.14 to 0.28 bumps in Oct-Nov have no evidence of introducing sync native creates), so this is latent dependency/platform exposure rather than a regression.
